title: Roles and Permissions Web Application
tagline: A secure web app with dynamic roles and permissions management using React and Laravel.
description: Developed a web application with a robust roles and permissions system using React and Laravel. Implemented user authentication, authorization, and dynamic role management. Enhanced security and streamlined user access control.

overview.problem: Managing users with different access levels and permissions manually is inefficient and insecure.
overview.solution: A web application with dynamic roles and permissions, enabling secure access control and role-based functionalities.
overview.goal: Build a secure, scalable, and user-friendly platform for role-based user management.

features: Integration with Laravel backend using Inertia.js

architecture.description: The app follows a modular architecture separating frontend (React), backend (Laravel), and database layers, with Inertia.js bridging them.

challenges.problem: Handling complex roles and permissions logic dynamically
challenges.solution: Used Spatie Permissions package with middleware for scalable access control

challenges.problem: Integrating React frontend seamlessly with Laravel backend
challenges.solution: Used Inertia.js for smooth SPA-like experience without full page reloads

metrics: Streamlined user management for multiple roles
Enhanced maintainability and scalability of the system

futureImprovements: Add audit logs for user actions
Implement real-time notifications for role changes

title: Magic Link Authentication Web Application
tagline: Passwordless authentication system using secure Magic Links built with MERN stack.
description: Developed a secure passwordless authentication system using the MERN stack. Implemented Magic Link login via email, JWT-based verification, and secure token expiration handling. Enhanced user experience by eliminating passwords while maintaining strong security standards.

overview.problem: Traditional password-based authentication is vulnerable to security risks like weak passwords, phishing, and credential leaks.
overview.solution: Implemented passwordless authentication using time-limited secure magic links sent to user email for login verification.
overview.goal: Provide a secure, scalable, and seamless passwordless authentication experience.

features: Responsive UI using React and Tailwind CSS

architecture.description: The application follows a modular MERN architecture separating frontend, backend, and database layers with secure token-based communication.
flow: Server generates secure token → MongoDB stores hashed token with expiry
Magic link sent via email → User clicks link
Server verifies token → Issues JWT session

challenges.problem: Ensuring token security and preventing reuse attacks
challenges.solution: Stored hashed tokens in MongoDB with strict expiration and one-time usage validation

challenges.problem: Handling expired or invalid links gracefully
challenges.solution: Implemented frontend and backend validation with proper error handling and regeneration option

metrics: Improved login security by eliminating password vulnerabilities
Enhanced scalability with JWT-based session handling

futureImprovements: Add admin dashboard for login analytics

title: College Event Management System (EMS)
tagline: Role-Based Event Management System with Student Panel and Admin Dashboard built using Next.js.
description: Developed a full-stack Event Management System for handling college events using Next.js 15. The platform includes a Student Panel and Admin Dashboard with Role-Based Authentication (RBA). Implemented secure authentication using NextAuth and JWT, event creation and approval workflows, participant registration, and dynamic PDF generation for reports. Designed a responsive UI using Tailwind CSS and Flowbite-React.

overview.problem: Managing college events manually leads to inefficiencies in registrations, approvals, tracking participants, and report generation.
overview.solution: Built a centralized web-based Event Management System with separate dashboards for students and admins, including role-based access control and automated event workflows.
overview.goal: Provide a scalable and secure platform to efficiently manage college events with structured user roles and automated processes.

features: Secure login system using NextAuth and JWT
Event creation and management by Admin
Dynamic PDF report generation using jsPDF
Responsive UI using Tailwind CSS and Flowbite

architecture.description: The application follows a modern Next.js full-stack architecture using App Router with API routes, MongoDB database, and secure authentication layer.

challenges.problem: Implementing secure role-based route protection in Next.js App Router
challenges.solution: Used middleware and session validation with NextAuth and JWT to restrict routes based on user roles

challenges.problem: Managing dynamic event registration data efficiently
challenges.solution: Designed optimized MongoDB schemas with proper indexing and relational references using Mongoose

metrics: Reduced manual paperwork and tracking errors
Centralized dashboard for streamlined event handling
Enhanced security with role-based access control

futureImprovements: Email notification system for event updates
Cloud file storage integration for event materials

title: Smart CRUD – Multi-Workspace Task Management System
tagline: Advanced MERN-based task management platform with workspace segmentation and analytics dashboard.
description: Smart CRUD is a full-stack MERN application designed to manage daily tasks across multiple workspaces such as Students, Working Professionals, Government Aspirants, and Job Seekers. The system allows users to create, track, analyze, and download daily task reports. Built with Next.js 16, Clerk authentication, Express 5, and MongoDB, the platform focuses on productivity tracking, analytics visualization, and structured workspace management.

overview.problem: Individuals from different backgrounds struggle to consistently track and analyze their daily productivity across various goals and domains.
overview.solution: Built a multi-workspace task management system where users can categorize tasks by role (Student, Professional, Govt Aspirant, Job Seeker), track daily progress, and generate analytical reports.
overview.goal: Provide a scalable productivity system with structured workspace separation, real-time tracking, and downloadable performance reports.

features: Separate workspaces for Students, Professionals, Govt Aspirants, and Job Seekers
Responsive UI with Tailwind CSS v4 and MUI
Secure backend API with Express and MongoDB

architecture.description: The application follows a modern MERN architecture with Next.js frontend, Express TypeScript backend, and MongoDB database. Authentication is handled via Clerk with secure API communication through Axios.
flow: Task CRUD operations via Express API
Data stored and retrieved from MongoDB

challenges.solution: Structured MongoDB schemas with workspace-based references and optimized queries
Implemented backend aggregation pipelines for productivity metrics
